reason: $13 a visit or $45 a month is a lot when the Salisbury Zoo, library storytime and the parks cost me nothing. I might use the free first visit out of curiosity, but I would not pay after that.
objection: $45 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price around $5 to $6 a visit, or a few free open-play days a month.
